title: Statistics
description: One measurement tells you little; a thousand tell you how much to trust the next. Unlocks the Statistics Engine and the Confidence Seal.

puzzle.goal: n measurements with spread σ are averaged. Write the margin E their mean is within, at a confidence of z standard errors.
puzzle.name: Square-root law
puzzle.ask: Find E for z = @{z}, σ = @{σ} and n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: Errors add in quadrature: the sum of n has spread σ√n, so the mean has σ√n / n.
